package_recipe: P3 retains exact directory/resource bytes from v0.0.8 P2. Each M record: compressed length, original length, codec=1 (raw DEFLATE-9), CRC32 of original compact_q text; then compressed bytes. Both APEs use the same driver prefix. No binary encoding or model changes.
decision: No shipping integration: private compressed versus same instrumented uncompressed driver calc median regresses 8.858ms (>5ms target), versus shipped artifact 11.690ms. Investigate binary representation as a separate experiment; do not claim that experiment has already succeeded.
